::: {#exm-pretraining}

#### Hiding characters

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)
first_line = text[:text.index("\n")]
hidden = torch.rand(len(first_line), generator=generator) < 0.15
masked_line = "".join("_" if h else ch for ch, h in zip(first_line, hidden.tolist()))
print(first_line)
print(masked_line)
```

Hiding each character with probability 0.15 turns the first line of the text into the input `r paste0('"', py$masked_line, '"')`.
A network [pretrained](#def-pretraining) in the second way learns to fill each gap from the characters on both sides of it.
The `train_lm()` of this lecture uses the objective of the first way,
on `r format(py$n_train, big.mark = ",")` characters rather than the billions of tokens of real [language models](language-models.qmd#def-language-model).

:::
